evidence.proved: the free plan runs on one server in Germany, with random tunnel names and a per-connection time limit that the page gives no number for
evidence.quote: The network comes with a free plan that is limited to the free server in our data center in Germany, uses randomized tunnel names for every connection and has a time limit for every connection.

evidence.proved: the Hobby plan needs a free account and no card
evidence.quote: Get up and running with a free account. No card required.

evidence.proved: sign-in is by email address, GitHub or Google
evidence.quote: Expose opens your browser, where you sign in with your email address, GitHub or Google.

evidence.proved: sharing a TCP port is marked as a Pro feature, so the free plan carries HTTP and HTTPS only
the client shares HTTP and HTTPS traffic
evidence.quote: Expose allows you to share any kind of HTTP/HTTPS traffic for websites that you can reach on your own computer, with anyone on the internet and there are multiple ways to share a site with Expose.

evidence.proved: the free server accepts client connections on port 443
evidence.quote: The free default server is already running on port 443.

evidence.proved: the managed network is a separate proprietary service from the MIT-licensed PHP core that the self-hosted record covers
evidence.quote: The managed platform itself is proprietary.
